# `features/rich-text-editor/tiptap`

Configure a custom TipTap engine or schema for RichTextEditor; the default editor already uses TipTap.

## Selection

- **Use when:** Configure a custom TipTap engine or schema for RichTextEditor; the default editor already uses TipTap.
- **Avoid when:** The default StarterKit and mention schema already meets the editing requirements.
- **Consider instead:** `features/rich-text-editor`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { createTiptapEngine } from "themelia-ui/features/rich-text-editor/tiptap"
```

## Optional peers

Install these only when importing this family:

```bash
npm install @tiptap/core @tiptap/pm @tiptap/starter-kit
```

This family has no component-family dependencies.

Application policy—routing, fetching, persistence, permissions, and translation—stays
outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.
